[[Spectral Wand]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] obtained from [[Grahame]] in [[Lion's Arch Keep]] after completion of [[The Battle for Lion's Arch]] in exchange for 10 [[Medal of Honor|Medals of Honor]]. As the name would suggest, this wand is a replica of the one [[Lucent the Spectral]] wields. 

==Stats==
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Fast Casting]])
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Viridian Scepter]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact replica of this item with:
*One of the following Fast Casting wands:
**[[Asuran Scepter]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Rod]] from collector [[Zaishen Mesmeric Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Scepter]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Fan of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Scepter]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Scepter]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Arcane Scepter]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Charr Scepter]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Scepter]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Scepter]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Scepter]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Wand Wrapping]] [[of Quickening]]
*Perfect [["Hale and Hearty"]] inscription

==Unique counterparts==
*[[Mina's Gaze]] has nearly identical stats to this item; however, it requires [[Domination Magic]].
*[[Mallyx's Whim]] has nearly identical stats to this item; however, it requires [[Inspiration Magic]].
